A later numerical failure does not erase earlier complete horizons. A timeout or native crash makes the entire affected arm unavailable; its checkpointed data remain descriptive only.

setup.as_shipped: Unchanged old adapter and selectedIC. Instrument only read-only engine/actuator properties.
setup.engine_bootstrap: Immediately after successful native run_ic, call get_propulsion().init_running(-1) exactly once, including no-engine cases. No additional run, wait, reset, command restoration, trim, governor/SCAS/mixture/control-mode override. ExistingICrunning instructions still occur in botharms.
setup.implementation: Process-local forwarding FGFDMExec factory proxy wrapping unchanged adapter, restored in finally; no concurrent simulator instances withinworker. Hook eachfresh parent,replay,factual/probe identically.
setup.interpretation: Startup package changes internal throttle/mixture, FCS mixture, subclass startup and iterative engine steady-state calculations. Effect is not isolated running-bit effect. Electric/rocket power need not follow running flag. Record pre/post state, time, command baseline, engine diagnostics, call/return/failure.
setup.startup_evidence: Record startup attempted_count and returned_count and exception. Read pre/post snapshots from the underlying FDM directly without recursing through the observation hook. A native run_ic failure is distinct from a subsequent bootstrap failure.

telemetry.failures: Absent paths are excluded with an explicit absent roster. Present getters returning nonfinite or RuntimeError produce NaN plus false validity and a saved error reason; never substitute zero or introduce an additional physical-failure gate. Programming errors escape. Telemetry comparison requires validity; unavailable telemetry is not a weak response. Align telemetry to successfully validated observations, retaining a separate failed-boundary row where captured.

telemetry.selection: Use the following ordered global properties, then for each engine index the ordered engine suffixes and FCS fields. Retain only paths present in the loaded property catalog; save every absent path. Values retain native units specified by property names; n1/n2 are percent. Never create or write a diagnostic property.
